title: When the Summer Sings
author: Jonah Reyes
blurb: Juniper Delacroix, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
